layout.observation: Reference shows a wide paper-like field with mixed grotesk/serif hero, alternating offset portfolio media and generous negative space; V0 reconstructs the shell grid (12-column, offset media/copy pairing, editorial statement sections) with original placeholder content, but exact column ratios and section counts differ.
layout.evidence_source: reference/captures/desktop-initial-9228172552eb.webp paired with deterministic V0 desktop initial capture; reference-observation.json visual_analysis.desktop_initial
layout.engine_inference: V0 uses a 12-column grid with alternating 7/5 and 5/7 media/copy spans; the reference alternates media left/right with irregular vertical rhythm.
limitations: Ordered stills cannot prove the reference's responsive reflow behavior beyond the two captured viewports.

typography.observation: Reference hero mixes grotesk and serif at extreme display scale with tight tracking; V0 reproduces the mixed-family display treatment (sans display plus serif counterpart), tight negative letter-spacing and weight contrast, using open system font stacks instead of the reference's licensed fonts.
typography.evidence_source: reference/captures/desktop-initial-9228172552eb.webp and desktop-mid-scroll-f73214a1107a.webp paired with V0 desktop initial and mid-scroll captures
typography.engine_inference: V0 display sizes clamp between 3.35rem and 8.15rem with -7.5 percent tracking on display sans; serif counterparts at 400 weight. Reference font files are licensed and were not retrieved.
limitations: Reference uses licensed typefaces that cannot be copied; V0 substitutes open system stacks, so glyph geometry differs by design.

color.observation: Reference works a restrained monochrome shell (paper/ink) with sparse violet accent and sculptural pale media; V0 reproduces paper/ink monochrome plus violet and acid accents, with the contact section inverted to violet.
color.evidence_source: reference/captures/desktop-initial-9228172552eb.webp and desktop-final-ddf04b326ac2.webp paired with V0 desktop initial and final captures
color.engine_inference: V0 palette is paper neutral, ink near-black, violet accent, acid secondary accent; the reference presents a similar two-neutral plus violet scheme.
limitations: Reference colors were read from stills, not extracted from licensed stylesheets; V0 values are original approximations.

spacing.observation: Reference maintains generous macro whitespace with editorial section padding; V0 uses clamp-based section padding between 7rem and 15rem and consistent 1rem grid gutters approximating the reference rhythm.
spacing.evidence_source: reference/captures/desktop-mid-scroll-f73214a1107a.webp paired with V0 desktop mid-scroll capture
spacing.engine_inference: V0 macro spacing scales via clamp section padding; rhythm is regularized where the reference is intentionally non-uniform.

asset_treatment.observation: Reference media are sculptural pale photographic objects; V0 reconstructs the treatment as pure-CSS sculptural compositions (soft-shadow letterform object, conic-gradient disc, striped ledger field) with zero external assets.
asset_treatment.evidence_source: reference/captures/desktop-mid-scroll-f73214a1107a.webp paired with V0 desktop signature-hover capture
asset_treatment.engine_inference: All V0 visuals are CSS-generated (gradients, shadows, clip-path); no proprietary reference asset was downloaded or copied.
limitations: Reference photography treatment is approximated, not reproduced; fidelity of asset treatment is inherently partial.

depth.observation: Reference creates depth through layering (hero text over sculptural media, seal overlays, collage planes); V0 reconstructs a z-layered hero (text over object over collage) and inset-shadow sculptural treatments.
depth.evidence_source: reference/captures/desktop-initial-9228172552eb.webp paired with V0 desktop initial capture
depth.engine_inference: V0 hero uses three stacked planes (headline z2, hero-object z1, collage absolute) plus a rotating seal at z3; the reference uses a similar plane ordering.

hierarchy.observation: Reference establishes a clear editorial hierarchy: display hero, quiet nav, section statements at intermediate scale, micro-labels; V0 mirrors the scale steps (display, statement, body, micro-label) with explicit weights and letter-spacing per tier.
hierarchy.evidence_source: reference/captures/desktop-initial-9228172552eb.webp and mobile-initial-3747e071d7b6.webp paired with V0 desktop initial and mobile initial captures
hierarchy.engine_inference: V0 scale ratio display:statement:body:micro is approximately 8.15rem to 7rem to 1.05rem to 0.66rem, matching the reference's four-tier structure.

motion.observation: Reference stills cannot prove animation timing or easing (stated evidence_limit in reference-observation.json); V0 implements scroll-reveal choreography and hover transitions entirely through kinetic motion tokens (out-expo and out-quint curves, duration tokens, stagger), the KINETIC-sanctioned approximation.
motion.evidence_source: reference/captures/desktop-project-hover-929fe188a6b3.webp paired with V0 desktop signature-hover capture and the persisted motion-token report
motion.engine_inference: V0 motion uses out-expo and out-quint easing tokens with duration-slow and duration-page tokens for reveals and hover; the reduced-motion variant is captured as a separate state.
limitations: Still captures cannot verify the reference's actual easing curves; V0 motion is an approximation licensed under the motion token catalog, not a measurement.

scroll_choreography.observation: Reference mid-scroll stills show alternating editorial statements and offset media at wide intervals; V0 reconstructs the same narrative ordering (hero, manifesto, capabilities, work, index, contact) with intersection-observer reveals at threshold 0.12.
scroll_choreography.evidence_source: reference/captures/desktop-mid-scroll-f73214a1107a.webp paired with V0 desktop mid-scroll and final captures
scroll_choreography.engine_inference: V0 reveal choreography: each section reveals once when 12 percent visible, no re-trigger; reference scroll behavior is observed only as ordered stills.
limitations: Scroll-linked motion in the reference (if any) is unproven by stills; V0 uses reveal-only choreography as the conservative reconstruction.

interaction.observation: Reference exposes a large circular arrow affordance on project hover (state change proven, timing unproven); V0 reconstructs the same affordance pattern (circular action button appearing on media hover) with focus-visible parity and a collapsed mobile menu.
interaction.evidence_source: reference/captures/desktop-project-hover-929fe188a6b3.webp paired with V0 desktop signature capture and mobile menu-open capture
interaction.engine_inference: V0 hover states use scale and opacity tokens with a 1250ms stable checkpoint; menu-open is a separate mobile state; focus-visible mirrors hover.
limitations: Reference hover timing and easing are unproven; V0 interaction timing is a token-driven approximation.

transition_behavior.observation: Reference transition behavior is unmeasured (stills only); V0 transitions are fully token-governed (cubic-bezier tokens, duration tokens, stagger constants) and validated by the motion-token validator with a captured reduced-motion state.
transition_behavior.evidence_source: V0 desktop reduced-motion capture and signature capture; motion-token report runs/case-ee9eaf0dc9/reports/motion-token-v0.json
transition_behavior.engine_inference: All V0 transitions resolve to kinetic tokens; the reduced-motion capture proves transitions are fully suppressed under prefers-reduced-motion.
limitations: Reference transition curves remain unmeasured; equivalence to reference timing is not claimed.

narrative_pacing.observation: Reference paces a long editorial scroll with alternating statement and media blocks at generous intervals; V0 reconstructs the same pacing (six sections, alternating composition, macro padding) but shortens total length relative to the reference.
narrative_pacing.evidence_source: reference/captures/desktop-mid-scroll-f73214a1107a.webp and desktop-final-ddf04b326ac2.webp paired with V0 mid-scroll and final captures
narrative_pacing.engine_inference: V0 total scroll depth is approximately half the reference's; section ordering and alternation match.
limitations: Pacing equivalence is not claimed; V0 is a fidelity study of grammar, not a replica.

coverage_summary: All 12 dimensions carry paired reference and V0 capture evidence. Layout grammar, hierarchy, color shell, spacing rhythm, scroll choreography and interaction affordances are reconstructed from one-off observe-only reference evidence; motion, transitions and asset treatment are KINETIC token-governed approximations because stills cannot measure the reference's timing. Licensed fonts and photographic assets are deliberately approximated, never copied.
approval_reason: Explicit human approval received for the V0 fidelity study at the HUMAN V0 FIDELITY GATE.
